question: Identify the top 10 Citibike stations by highest proportion of group rides, defined as trips starting and ending at the same station where multiple riders departed/arrived within the same 2-minute time window. Calculate the proportion as the number of trips that are part of a group divided by the total number of trips ending at that station.
sql:
WITH same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    end_station_id,
    starttime,
    LAG(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id, end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as prev_start,
    LEAD(starttime) OVER (PARTITION BY start_station_id, end_station_id ORDER BY starttime) as next_start
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
marked AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    end_station_id,
    starttime,
    CASE WHEN 
      (prev_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(starttime, prev_start, SECOND) <= 120) OR
      (next_start IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(next_start, starttime, SECOND) <= 120)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as in_group
  FROM same_station_trips
),
group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    SUM(in_group) as trips_in_groups
  FROM marked
  WHERE in_group = 1
  GROUP BY 1
),
total_ending AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id as station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips_ending
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.name, CAST(gs.start_station_id AS STRING)) as station_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(gs.trips_in_groups, te.total_trips_ending) as proportion
FROM group_counts gs
JOIN total_ending te ON gs.start_station_id = te.station_id
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` s ON CAST(gs.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
